BiblicalUsage: Isaiah says the Lord will make Jerusalem's Ariel, her groaning, heavy with sorrow, and Lamentations takes up the groaning of a city in mourning. The word is the sound of a people in distress, a groan that has no words left.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for groaning holds no doctrine of its own; its sorrow is the prophets', that a city can be brought so low its only speech is a groan.
